spec.title: Kamiwaza · Platform Overview
spec.description: Platform readiness as the operator reports it, with stability, resources, and events.

spec.title: Platform
spec.description: The platform's Ready condition

spec.title: Capabilities ready
spec.description: Capabilities reporting Ready or ExternalReady

spec.title: Progressing
spec.description: Capabilities still converging

spec.title: Blocked
spec.description: Capabilities that need a change to intent, policy, or a prerequisite

spec.title: Served models ready
spec.description: ModelDeployments whose Ready condition is True

spec.title: Release
spec.description: Current platform release and the reconciling operator version

spec.title: Capability state over time
spec.description: Each capability's state as the operator reported it, over the selected range

spec.expr: max by (component) ((kamiwaza_platform_component_state{namespace="$namespace", component=~".+", state="DisabledByPlan"} == 1) * 0 or (kamiwaza_platform_component_state{namespace="$namespace", component=~".+", state=~"Ready|ExternalReady"} == 1) * 1 or (kamiwaza_platform_component_state{namespace="$namespace", component=~".+", state="Progressing"} == 1) * 2 or (kamiwaza_platform_component_state{namespace="$namespace", component=~".+", state="Blocked"} == 1) * 3)

spec.description: Every capability with its state and stable reason

spec.description: Standard conditions on the KamiwazaPlatform resource

spec.title: CPU by workload
spec.description: CPU cores by app.kubernetes.io/name

spec.expr: sum by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name!=""}))

spec.title: Memory by workload
spec.description: Working-set memory by app.kubernetes.io/name

spec.expr: sum by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name!=""}))

spec.title: Largest memory consumers
spec.description: Current working-set memory by workload

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name!=""})))

spec.title: Busiest workloads (CPU cores)
spec.description: Current CPU cores by workload

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_app_kubernetes_io_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_app_kubernetes_io_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_app_kubernetes_io_name!=""})))

spec.title: Volume usage
spec.description: Persistent volume claims by utilisation (needs kubelet volume statistics)
